svg.aria-label: Hi, I am Mike: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Solutions Architect. Pixel-art developer, seen from behind, coding on an iMac while Claude's mascot waves from the desk and Kira, a white Pomeranian girl with a pink bow, walks calmly across the floor and stops to bark when the push lands.
svg.title: Mike · Senior Software Engineer
